title: Enterprises are overpaying for simple AI queries — Snowflake's gateway now auto-routes to cut costs up to 3x
summary: Snowflake’s Cortex AI Gateway now offers dynamic model routing to address that: enterprises can select “auto” instead of a fixed model, and the system routes each task to whichever model offers the best combination of quality and cost.
